newsitem.title: USA: ING Barings expands new U.S. high-yield bond group.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings expands new U.S. high-yield bond group.

text.p: ING Barings took the latest step in staffing its new junk bond department by naming Greg Croll as head of high-yield trading, investment bank officials said.
Croll was formerly the portfolio manager for ING Barings' high-yield investment portfolio. He will report to Americo Da Corte, head of fixed-income trading.
Buck Burnaman, head of the proprietary investing group at ING Barings, will temporarily replace Croll as portfolio manager until a replacement can be found.

ING Barings' officials say they hope to develop a significant presence in the U.S. high-yield market by exploiting their strengths in the emerging markets. Sources said ING Barings also has strong relationships with oil and gas and telecommunications sector issuers.
"There is a convergence going on between emerging markets and high-yield in the U.S.; that is really our edge," said Dan Negrea, managing director and head of high-yield originations at ING Barings.
Negrea came to the investment bank approximately six months ago from Chase Securities Inc, where he served as a managing director in high-yield originations.
Sources say ING Barings plans to hire individuals to head high-yield sales and research in the near future. It also expects to add more staff in originations, sales and trading, they noted.

In the past several months, ING served as co-manager on several U.S. junk bond deals. They included a $215 million offering for Abraxas Petroleum Corp, a $300 million deal for Parker Drilling Co, and a $125 million offering for Phonetel Technologies Inc.
ING Barings is the investment banking subsidiary of Dutch financial services firm, ING Groep NV.
